handoff: While a route is pending with no free ship and cash below ship price plus the keep-cash floor, a red line runs from the source planet to the cursor (or the hovered planet), with the warning WARN_SHIP_UNAFFORDABLE (need/have) next to the cursor. main.route_unaffordable() reuses can_buy_ship, so it clears on a free ship, enough cash, cancel, route placed, cap reached or game over. It reads live, so it also works while paused. Headless tests pass; a windowed shot confirmed the red line and Russian text. English and Russian were added by targeted appends.

details.how_to_try: Start a run, set cash below 900 with 0 ships (debug menu), click a planet, choose Send to..., then move the mouse. Raise cash and the warning goes. Esc cancels it.

not_checked_by_eye: English text wording on screen, other zoom levels, window sizes below 1920x1080
